name: Gaming
notes: Both sources want a Pyro DMG goblet, CRIT circlet and EM or ATK% sands; the set depends on the reaction. KQM lists Crimson Witch, Long Night's Oath, Gilded Dreams, Marechaussee Hunter and Vermillion Hereafter; Game8's top build is Marechaussee Hunter, then Crimson Witch, then a Burgeon build (EM everywhere, Flower of Paradise Lost). Marechaussee is first because it is Game8's lead and KQM includes it; the Burgeon build is left out as a niche. Goals are Game8's: ATK 1,800+, CRIT DMG 160, ER 150-180 (160; KQM Bennett 170-180 at C0, 130-135 at C4+), EM 100 baseline; CRIT Rate 45-55 with Marechaussee (50), 70-80 with other sets. Damage talent: the Skill's plunge (elemental curve, 1.8x at level 10) and the Burst are both elemental; priority Skill > Burst > Normal Attack in both. Weapons differ in order only; the first is KQM's. Partners are Cryo (Melt), Hydro (Vaporize), Dendro (Burgeon) from KQM's reaction sets.
